あらすじ

“The goddess who promised to marry me when I was a child…!?”

In order to shorten the commuting time to school (five hours round trip!), which had been bothering him, the protagonist, Kotarou, ends up living in his grandparents’ mansion.

What awaits him there is a girl named Lilium, who calls herself: “Your wife”

item.title: Annabel Maidgarden
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Barista Lab
  • 発売日: 2020-06-26
  • スコア: 6.68/10 (53 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アナベル・メイドガーデン
  • 英語名: Annabel Maidgarden

别名

  • アナメイ

あらすじ

My childhood friend is my fiancée and my… maid!?

It was the day before summer break. On that day, the protagonist, Kuzuhara Kei, was given an astonishing instruction from his father:

“You have a fiancée. Go greet her.”

Kei, still harboring unrequited feelings for his childhood friend Annabel , proceeded to the meeting place planning to decline the marriage proposal. But waiting there for him was… Annabel in maid clothes.
